purpose: Visual reference for the Cocina Ery floor and countertop; not a manufacturer sample.
origin: Built-in image_gen editing of the v6 ceramic: modestly warmer/more saturated using the former floor for color guidance; second image_gen edit rearranges the same ceramic into aligned squares.
floor: Existing floor mesh (SketchUp persistent ID 36688), rectangular ceramic applied as the fixed baseline of the web model. Same map as the rectangular countertop; tint is independent.

wood_reference.source: Built-in image_gen edit of ambientCG Wood026 (CC0-1.0), light fine-grained reddish wood inspired by mahogany; visual reference, not a commercial sample.
wood_reference.placement: Front and left vertical edge, backsplash and a flush 3 cm strip inward on the existing countertop surface. Top strips meet with a mitre; the cooker gap and right edge remain unchanged.
